title: On the Natural History of Unrest

description.main: Unnar Örn's On the Natural History of Unrest (Unnar Örn Forlag, Reykjavík, 2016) collects black-and-white photographs and bitmap images of large crowds at protests and other activist events. Edition of 300, signed and numbered.
description.extended:
Unnar Örn's On the Natural History of Unrest is a book of black-and-white photographs and bitmap images that show large crowds at protests and other activist events.

The photographs are cropped wide, and the book gives no descriptions or other text to say what is shown. Each event can be studied in detail, with little to distract from the crowd itself. The book has a Swiss binding and a soft orange cover with monochrome bitmap images on the front and back. It runs to about 196 pages, measures 17 × 11 cm and was offset printed. Unnar Örn Forlag published it in Reykjavík in 2016, in an edition of 300, signed and numbered.

notes: Printed Matter stock ID 110827 B; sewn bound, offset printed, black-and-white, page count given as [196]. Artist's own imprint. Printed Matter files the artist as Unnar Orn, with the brand line Unnar Örn Audarson; sorted here under Örn, which may want changing. No ISBN, artist site or larger cover found: the cover is 129 x 206 px, the largest Printed Matter serves, so it belongs in the low-res covers backlog.
